Day 1

As my introduction to Tallinn I arrived early in the mornign when it is freezing. I will be staying close to 5 days here because well it is new year. So I took it relatively easy. For this day I only visied the Maritime museum, I really enjoyed the exhibit. One of the exhibits simulate water presure and it help me appericate the cocnept of barotrauma. Another segment involves piloting a boat which I was terribel at. To end the day off I got some KFC and rest in

Day 2 New Years Eve

So for this day I saw a few really cute birds, hanging outside Viru. I end up heading ot the Maritime Musuem at Fat Margaret, and sat the boat I will be taking to head to Finland. I also briefly visit a prison museum and saw the inhumane suitation that the dissenters were imprisoned in.

I did walk past a lot of pro russian protest, I was a little curious and it became clear when I check my map and this is the Russian embassy. The Old Town area was quite beautiful and I saw quite a bit of buildings. Before new year I visited the Vabamu Museum of Occupations and Freedom, they showcase a lot of how life was like in various occupations, they even have a old Soviet drink dispenser that is still functional.

As the year come to the close I joined the Estonia new year festival, I thought it was really cool even through I didn’t really understand much, someone important I think the prime minister of Estonia appeared on screen to give a speech and everyone is cheering. This was my first year spending new years outside of Singapore.
